scope: Static source contract, not a new runtime inventory or pins package

additionalFields.additionalRootInclusiveRoots: Canonical absolute unique directory roots, no overlaps with old roots/each other or current package/review in either direction
additionalFields.additionalRootInclusiveRows: Separate list of full metadata/nonregular targets and SHA256 for every listed regular file; root itself plus all descendants

pathsetEquation: legacy descendant pathset == legacy row paths; union of each additional {root,*rglob} == additional row paths; combined union == unique full row pathset; missing/added/duplicate rows reject
futureAdditionalOriginals: More independently frozen completed old-package roots can be added as data without changing guard source; later prep2 must also include rejected old-business prep1 as278 root-inclusive rows. That runtime inventory/pins assembly is not authorized here.
runtimeProtectionBoundary: At every existing guard invocation, verify only explicitly inventory-bound immutable old originals plus existing source/native/tools/freeze/cache and repository metadata contract. No blanket full-context/external content hashing is added.
staticClosureBoundary: Existing full static context/external inventories remain source/package review evidence; sealing their files does not itself actively guard underlying originals.
notClaimed: Business old/new or default-editor after credit
